# MachineSense report — imbalance__10g__13.9264

Research demonstration; development results; not validated for real machines.

## Verdict
**further inspection needed**. Decision rule: provisional research setting: The decision rule is a provisional setting, not a final rule selection; the final choice will be made later under stated assumptions about fault frequency and costs.

The recording did not pass the classifier's confidence and familiarity checks, so it is reported as needing further inspection rather than as a known condition.

## Checks against the calibrated thresholds
- Classifier confidence (MSP) 0.998861 < 0.998895: fail (margin -3.418e-05, -3.093 % on the 1 − MSP scale).
- Familiarity (Mahalanobis distance) 9.9277 ≤ 30.04: pass (margin -20.11, -66.954 %).
- Autoencoder error 0.588542 > 0.243072: above healthy limit — consistent with a fault (margin +0.3455, +142.126 %).
- Speed-aware baseline (B1s) 1.8639 > 0.872143: above healthy limit — consistent with a fault (margin +0.9917, +113.709 %).

All 4 alternative decision rules agree.

## Most probable classes (CNN-6 scores)
- imbalance 0.9989, vertical misalignment 0.0003, normal 0.0002
- Secondary logistic regression's top class: imbalance
- Model scores are not the probability that the diagnosis is correct.

## Signal quality
- Measured shaft speed 13.58 Hz (815 rpm); speed stable within the recording (0.94 %).
- Warning: healthy thresholds were not calibrated at this speed; a healthy verdict is less reliable

## Bearing frequencies at the measured speed
BPFO 40.7 Hz, BPFI 67.9 Hz, BSF 25.4 Hz, BSF DEFECT LINE 2X 50.8 Hz, FTF 5.1 Hz.

## Secondary logistic-regression evidence
These are feature contributions of the secondary logistic-regression model; they explain that model, not the main neural network's decision. Top features for imbalance:
- largest |sample| in the window (underhang tangential) [f_under_tangential_peak]: contribution +0.912
- RMS of the window (DC removed) (underhang tangential) [f_under_tangential_rms]: contribution +0.862
- amplitude at 0.5× the window's shaft speed (overhang tangential) [f_over_tangential_o0p5]: contribution +0.614
- excess kurtosis (Fisher) of the window (underhang axial) [f_under_axial_kurtosis]: contribution +0.606
- amplitude at 2× the window's shaft speed (overhang tangential) [f_over_tangential_o2]: contribution +0.510

## Limitations
- Research demonstration; development results; not validated for real machines.
- Calibrated on 5 healthy recordings; trained on speeds below 40 Hz and on the development pool only.
- Decision rule is a provisional research setting, not a final rule selection.
- The tested scores and rules do not consistently distinguish the imbalance / vertical-misalignment pair when one class is withheld. The classifier distinguishes them well when both are represented in training. This does not establish that no representation, training objective or decision method could help.
- Predicted fault location is according to the dataset labels; the classifier does not independently verify the physical sensor mapping. Per-channel reconstruction error is not fault-location evidence.
- Reserved-test eligibility: this bundle may be used for the final Q1 (healthy vs fault), Q2 (closed-set known condition) and severity / speed-block extrapolation tests, since no reserved recording was used; it is NOT eligible for the Q3 leave-one-class-out evaluation, because it was trained on all ten classes.
